items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: And Pansy Lane did join him, and Jack Loycanna on trombone.

ctx.x: By the way, in the old days, did you travel much, any of the bands you were with, did they get out of New Orleans?

Well, when I was a kid, I was playing around with Lane at the time. It was Pansy Lane. Yeah, Pansy Lane. And Jimmy Durante wanted me to join his band in New York. And Pansy Lane did join him, and Jack Loycanna on trombone. And Arnold, the deacon, on piano. No, on bass, that's right. He played bass with Jimmy Durante and Lane played the cornet. But he wanted me to join him. And then later on, Frank Christian was in New York. He wrote me. He wanted me to join him. But my mother said, well, I've got two boys away…
He stayed with him. He stayed with him.
